title: SecOps preview: new visuals
description: Trial of status history, stacked bars and annotations before they move into the main dashboards.

target.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, 'Patch Tuesday' AS text, 'patch-tuesday' AS tags FROM ( SELECT m + (((2 - extract(dow FROM m)::int + 7) % 7) + 7) * interval '1 day' AS t FROM generate_series(date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 month') m) x WHERE $__timeFilter(t)
SELECT min(started_at) AS time, 'First data from ' || collector AS text, 'feed' AS tags FROM collector_runs WHERE status IN ('ok', 'partial') GROUP BY collector HAVING $__timeFilter(min(started_at))

SELECT found::timestamptz AS time, what || coalesce(' (' || site_label || ')', '') || coalesce(': ' || status, '') AS text, 'action-log' AS tags FROM impact_actions WHERE found IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(found::timestamptz) AND (site_label IS NULL OR site_label IN ($site))

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT site_label FROM dim_site ORDER BY site_label = 'Ungrouped', site_label

options.content: **Preview** of three display ideas for the existing dashboards: a feed-health grid, stacked bars and chart annotations. Same data as the other dashboards; nothing here is new data. Once one is agreed it moves into its dashboard and this one goes. Hover the **i** on any panel for exactly what it counts.
Did each collector's data land, night by night? A vendor block or a credential that expired shows as a run of red or purple cells.

panels.title: Feed health by night

targets.rawSql: WITH days AS (SELECT generate_series('${__from:date}'::date, '${__to:date}'::date, interval '1 day')::timestamptz AS d), c AS (SELECT DISTINCT collector FROM collector_runs WHERE started_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND started_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1), last AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (collector, date_trunc('day', started_at)) collector, date_trunc('day', started_at) AS d, status, error FROM collector_runs WHERE started_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND started_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1 ORDER BY collector, date_trunc('day', started_at), started_at DESC) SELECT days.d AS time, c.collector AS metric, CASE WHEN l.status IS NULL THEN 4 WHEN l.status = 'ok' THEN 0 WHEN l.status = 'partial' THEN 1 WHEN l.error LIKE 'EdgeBlocked%' THEN 2 WHEN l.status = 'running' THEN 5 ELSE 3 END AS value FROM days CROSS JOIN c LEFT JOIN last l ON l.collector = c.collector AND l.d = days.d ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: One row per collector, one cell per day: how that collector's last run of the day ended. Blocked = the vendor refused us (e.g. a CDN block), not a bug here. Didn't run = no run that day (the 10:00 catch-up counts).

options.content: The same counts as the tables on the other dashboards, drawn so the worst team or week stands out without reading every column.

panels.title: Patch status by team

targets.rawSql: SELECT x.team AS "Team", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status IN ('Patched this cycle', 'Patched within 35 days')) AS "On track", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status IN ('Not patched yet (in window)', 'Patched, reboot pending (in window)')) AS "In window", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status IN ('Patched, reboot pending')) AS "Reboot pending", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status IN ('Behind: 35+ days')) AS "Behind 35+ days", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status IN ('Overdue: past deadline')) AS "Overdue", count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status IN ('No patch data')) AS "No patch data" FROM (SELECT trim(t) AS team, c.status FROM server_patch_compliance c CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(c.team, ',')) t WHERE c.site_label IN ($site)) x GROUP BY x.team ORDER BY count(*) FILTER (WHERE x.status = 'Overdue: past deadline') DESC, count(*) DESC

panels.description: Servers per team (from LogicMonitor) split by patch status, the same statuses as the Server patch compliance dashboard. A server several teams manage counts under each.

panels.title: Critical + high: opened vs fixed per week

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', snapshot_date), 'DD Mon') AS "Week of", sum(opened) AS "Opened", sum(fixed) AS "Fixed" FROM daily_vuln_flow_metrics WHERE severity IN ('critical', 'high') AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY date_trunc('week', snapshot_date) ORDER BY date_trunc('week', snapshot_date)

panels.description: Endpoint and external findings first seen vs fixed, per week (weeks start Monday). Fixed above opened = the backlog shrank.

options.content: Markers on the time axis of every chart on this dashboard: **blue** = Patch Tuesday, **green** = first data from a feed, **orange** = an action from the impact action log. Hover a marker for detail; toggle each kind at the top of the page. They explain jumps where they happen.

panels.title: Open critical + high by site

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, site_label AS metric, sum(crit + high) AS value FROM daily_site_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Open critical and high findings per site from the nightly snapshot. The markers are explained above the chart.
